title: Proof of rekt
tagline: @proofofrekt_ is a one-of-a-kind #web3community to share your 'rekt-periences' with PROOF!
description:
The native web3 social platform, where users can embed transaction within the post to prove and verify their actions, whether flex their gain or share their 'rekt-periences'. We believe that people needed mental support the most at the down time, and this is the good time to start doing this. 

The MVP will have these following features
🫥 Live Story Feed 
🫥 Verifiable 'rekt-periences'
🫥 Top-'rekt' leaderboard(rekt-derboard?)
🫥 Dedicately designed and Custom emojis #Web3 

Together we rekt, together we rise.!🤝 #proofofrekt🙃
how_its_made:
We build on top of social graph protocol 'Lens protocol'
- And using 'The graph' and 'Covalence' for wallet transactions filtering, 
NextJS. 
- [Tentatively] We will used POAP for minting "Proof of Rekt" to be a part of GTM strategy and gimmick for the users who join us in the first month. As a proof of market crash survivors 2022, which will definitely provide perks afterwards. And we will rise together as a community later on
